limitations: Media failure is a native code4 from nonmedia HTTP content assigned through public art.video.src; not a network-outage or all-decoder-failures claim.
Caller recognition Promise is controlled; media, PCM, errors and contexts are native.
Initial Firefox failures occurred before media error because a zero-PCM callback was held; guard now arms on nonzero PCM without loosening the audio assertion.
Source final covers core5.4.0 and candidate; final installed tests add actual core5.3.0 and normal no-audio/CORS/volume/mute controls.
WebKit WebAudio skips do not establish Safari or physical-device acceptance.
ASR-05, remote CI and release review gates remain open; no dependencies, lock or public declarations changed.
